usb_registry_scope: actual production constructor/pending allocator/new registry; generated directly at build, info/stats/logger dependencies. Initial state plus arbitrary u16 allocation bitmap/u64 next generation>=2 with allocated-slot representation consistent and prior generation=next-1; existing generations may coincide (relaxed reachable-state set). Covers fresh pending-only allocation/capacity/overflow/occupied preservation, not uniqueness of preexisting generations, registry concurrent ownership, detach, open/Ready, callbacks, credits or hardware. Unsupported warnings remain NOT_PROVEN even with successful raw solver output.
ingress_scope: single live identity, initially absent route, one publish and one retire; schedule_gate held through routes publication and closed before exact unpublication. CPU spinlock abstraction plus check/drop/publish weak control; no Arc/kref, IRQ nesting, registry reuse, callbacks, workqueue, Host, memory reclamation or hardware refinement
backend_install_scope: Abstract bounded registry publication safety:2 slots/2 candidates/global3 generations; atomic registry actions, nondeterministic allocation failure/retire/reuse/competing publication; no fairness/liveness, allocator/refcount/module/IRQ/callback/metadata-query/physical proof or implementation refinement. FinishRetire is an abstract joined-cleanup boundary, not a proof cleanup actually joins.

backend_scope: actual production descriptor validator over arbitrary u32 version/size/bus/capabilities/profile, u16 lengths/u8 counts and callback presence; live immutable provider-owned pointers assumed; no callback execution, module/context references, registration allocation/publication/retirement, concurrency or hardware proof
fd_grant_scope: actual production pure constructor and identity/direction predicate over arbitrary u64/u32 scopes and masks; zero/unminted and unsupported protected requests deny; not Host epoch, C socket/VFS/kref, trust/security-state/downgrade or hardware refinement
rx_scope: Host lock orders epoch validation and actual RX unlink/PEEK reference against withdrawal; CPU lock abstraction with weak check/drop/dequeue control, not C/Rust/VFS/queue refinement, wait/wakeup, copy completion, firmware or hardware proof
grant_scope: actual production pure lease constructor and one-step induction over all u64 epoch/representation states; successor never renews revoked epoch; not Managed/Host lock refinement, C socket/VFS, safety/security or hardware proof
session_scope: abstract contract only: two controllers/two lifetimes, fd aliases0..2 and pending/running work0..1 each; last close does not restart CMTC, joined references before free; not C/Rust/VFS refinement, lost wakeups, Grant/NOCP/hardware proof
binding_scope: actual binding initialization/representation/retire/busy/queue-space helpers; not C session work/VFS/kref refinement or hardware
ticket_scope: Host-locked validation/atomic submit vs Host withdrawal CPU order, with a weak check-drop-submit control; not C/Rust refinement, HCD internals, callback UAF, Grant epoch or NOCP reuse barrier
